model: GE EPM 4500 multi-point submeter via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: GE EPM 4500 multi-circuit submeters (up to 24 meter points) on Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the GE EPM 4500: 481 objects (472 AI, 9 AO), 364 polled by default. Per meter point it reads total kW, kvar, kVA and PF, then kWh, kvarh and instantaneous values (three-phase meters 1-8, then single/two-phase points); unpolled outputs handle the clock, interval data selection and data-ready flag.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile GE_EPM4500_Submeter_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the maker's Modbus register document (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/EPM4500.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 364 of the 481 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.

Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Internal Time - Hours/Minutes; Internal Time - Seconds; Internal Date - Month/Day...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.
Each meter point repeats the same group of objects at higher instances; map the points that are wired.

integration.summary: Map meter 1 total kW, meter 1 kWh and meter 1 power factor first. The listed objects are read-only.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
